_comment: Uncork store templates: the data-driven, extensible definition of every storefront Uncork can set up. Steam/Epic/GOG ship here as templates; developers add a new store with an entry (no app rebuild), and users create custom stores plus Save-as-Template exports in the same schema. A template is a store's metadata plus a reproducible bottle recipe (Wine engine/version, OS/winver, winetricks, dll overrides, launch flags/env) so 'Run Template' rebuilds a bottle as its author configured it. Loaded by app StoreTemplates.swift; user/dev additions also read from <UNCORK_DATA>/templates/*.json.
_schema: templates.<id>: { name, kind(steam|epic|gog|generic), platform(windows|mac), symbol, tagline, runsVia, setupNote, art{start,end (r,g,b 0..1)}, auth(bool), recipe{ engine, winver, winetricks[], dll_overrides{}, launch_flags[], env{} }, installer{ url?, file?, silent_args? }(generic only), launch_path?, detect_path? }
_kinds: steam/epic/gog = built-in, keep their bespoke sign-in UI + setup-<kind>.sh. generic = a developer/user store: installed via its installer into a bottle (Windows) or a native .app (mac), launched + detected + Library-scanned generically.

steam.name: Steam
steam.tagline: Valve's store, the biggest PC library.
steam.runsVia: Windows Steam client in a Wine bottle (auto-login cached)
steam.setupNote: Ready. Sign in once with a QR or password; stays signed in.

epic.name: Epic Games
epic.tagline: Fortnite, free weekly games, Unreal titles.
epic.runsVia: Legendary (lightweight CLI Epic client), no heavy launcher UI
epic.setupNote: Installs a CLI Epic client and lists your library in-app; sign in via browser code.

gog.name: GOG
gog.runsVia: Direct installers / Heroic-style, no launcher needed
gog.setupNote: DRM-free, so games can be installed directly without a running client.

battlenet.name: Battle.net
battlenet.tagline: Blizzard's launcher: WoW, Diablo, Overwatch, Call of Duty.
battlenet.setupNote: Installs Blizzard's native macOS Battle.net, so it runs directly with no Wine. This avoids the Windows installer's 'Updating Battle.net Update Agent' stall entirely. Sign in with your Blizzard account; Blizzard games with a Mac build (WoW, Diablo, Overwatch, Hearthstone, StarCraft) run natively.

itch.name: itch.io
itch.tagline: Indie games, tools and jams. Native macOS app.
itch.setupNote: Installs the native itch.io macOS app, so it runs directly with no Wine. Sign in with your itch account; most itch games are native Mac or DRM-free.
